{{Top|leg}}
'''Gravity boosters''' were used aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in order to change [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] orientation. They were built into the walls, ceilings, and decks of the station, and were used to change the orientation of a section's gravity.
